'''Daniel Raymond McClintock''' (born April 19, 1977) is a retired American professional [[basketball]] player at the [[Center (basketball)|center]] position. He is 7'0" and weighs 260 lb.

He attended [[Northern Arizona University]] before being selected with the 53rd overall pick in the [[2000 NBA draft|2000 draft]] by the [[National Basketball Association]]'s [[Denver Nuggets]]. McClintock's NBA career lasted only two weeks as during the [[2000–01 NBA season]], he only played six games from April 5 to April 18 while averaging 3.0 points and 2.8 rebounds per contest. His final NBA game was on April 18, 2001, in a 110–100 win over the Sacramento Kings. He recorded 2 points and 5 rebounds in his final game.

He later played for MBС Mykolaiv of the [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Ukrainian Basketball Super League|Basketball Super League]]<ref name="основной состав">[http://mbc.mk.ua/club/team МБК "Николаев" – основной состав] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20091007174013/http://mbc.mk.ua/club/team |date=2009-10-07 }} {{in lang|uk}}</ref> and other teams in Europe.
